title: zuelania crenata
intro: Zuelania crenata, commonly known as the "Wild Passion Fruit Tree", is a species of flowering plant in the family Passifloraceae, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Zuelania crenata include analgesic, antipyretic, and diuretic properties, making it a potential treatment for pain, fever, and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
